ActiveNotoriety.name: ActiveNotoriety
description: Reads notoriety selection from gump menu and returns a concatenated string.

TimeString.name: TimeString
description: Returns the current time in 12 hour format.

AutoEverything.name: AutoEverything
description: This is the function that houses a lot of the auto-action/chugging activation (apple, box, pies, warcry, seed, refresh, dex, str).

TimerCheck.name: TimerCheck
description: Script that is called by the AutoEverything script to check for timers for buffs (specifically Spellweaving).

AutoDrinkDexStr.name: AutoDrinkDexStr
description: Script that runs in the background, if turned on in the gump, to keep Dexterity and Strength pots up.

PopBox.name: PopBox
description: This function pops a box if the character is nerved or paralyzed.

NovaWhenLow.name: NovaWhenLow
description: A function to run in the background (activated in the gump) and if an OJ is within 4 tiles and below the percentage (set in the gump) it will auto nova.

Use_Nova.name: Use_Nova
description: Uses a supernova pot and adds a timer at the bottom of the screen.

Eat_Apple.name: Eat_Apple
description: Eats an apple and if the apple is succesfully eaten, adds a timer at the bottom of the screen.

Eat_Seed.name: Eat_Seed
description: Eats a Seed of Life.

Eat_Barrab.name: Eat_Barrab
description: Eats a Barrab pot.

Eat_Pie.name: Eat_Pie
description: Eats a pie based on the pie type passed into the function.  This function is called if a pie is selected to be eaten in the gump (Consumables tab).  Can be hotkeyed if you like as well.

DrinkCureHeal.name: DrinkCureHeal
description: A function to be hot-keyed.  If the player is poisoned it will chug a cure pot, otherwise it will chug a heal pot.

DrinkRefresh.name: DrinkRefresh
description: Drinks a refresh pot if Stamina < Max Stamina.

Blowup_Evade.name: Blowup_Evade
description: If you ahve multiple stacks of explosion pots, cooks them, and then evades before you they blow up.  With the latest patch, this script is likely not very useful.

ChainExplodePot.name: ChainExplodePot
description: While you have explosion pots in your pack, this script will constantly throw explosion pots at the last target.

ExplodeTimedThrow.name: ExplodeTimedThrow
description: A function to time throwing Explosion pots to hold them until the last possible second to throw and they still damage the character.

UseHealStone.name: UseHealStone
description: Uses a Heal Stone

Use_Smokebomb.name: Use_Smokebomb
description: Uses a smokebomb or egg.

Use_Conflag.name: Use_Conflag
description: Uses a conflag pot.

EatApple_standalone.name: EatApple_standalone
description: Old version of an eat apple script.  Would need to be hot-keyed and will only activate for Corpse, Sleep, or Mortal.

AutoSeed_standalone.name: AutoSeed_standalone
description: A standalone version of the auto-seed function.  Do not run this if you have it turned on in the gump.

RawReadFile.name: RawReadFile
description: This will read a text file and return a string array separated by lines.

ReadFiles.name: ReadFiles
description: This file read function is specific for reading files storing variables created by the write version.  Specifically for scripts like the SeedGatherer.  All newer scripts will be using JSON, so for the most part depricated.

FunctionLibraryObject.name: FunctionLibraryObject
description: Object structure to hold function descriptions and tags.

includeLibraryObject.name: includeLibraryObject
description: Object structure to hold include files used to iterate through and build function library

WardRemoval.name: WardRemoval
description: This script will rotate through the ward removal talisman's in your pack.  You will need to re-dress any talisman that you normally wear.

AutoBoxPop.name: AutoBoxPop
description: Standalone auto box popping if nerve striked or paralyzed. Shouldn't need to run this with the rest of the PvP pack.

AutoAfroHorse.name: AutoAfroHorse
description: Automatically uses a 16th aniversary horse, or VVV horse, and mounts it.

PopHorse.name: PopHorse
description: This is supposed to be an upgrade to the AutoAfroHorse, to pop a horse (VVV/16th Ani) and mount it.

ToggleAttackArea.name: ToggleAttackArea
description: This will highlight the attack area for the weapon in hand.  Designed for archers or throwers.

MountAndDismount.name: MountAndDismount
description: If the "MyMount" variable is set, it will mount the set mount.  This is set by a different function.

EquipSpellbookRes.name: EquipSpellbookRes
description: This is deisgned for mages that use <120 mage.  It will dress a set called "mage_book", which should have the +15 Magery spellbook in it, and then cast res to increase success.

FlagAllOJs.name: FlagAllOJs
description: This is a hot-keyable function that will flag all OJ's on the screen.

FlagAllOJs_Constant.name: FlagAllOJs_Constant
description: This is a function that has to be activated in the gump and will run in the background at all times and flag all OJ's on screen.

SelectTargetScrolling.name: SelectTargetScrolling
description: Scrolls through all mobiles on screen for the notoriety selected in the Gump.

SelectTargetScrollingBlue.name: SelectTargetScrollingBlue
description: Scrolls through all blue,grey, or criminal human mobiles on screen.

TargetNearestEnemy.name: TargetNearestEnemy
description: Sets the nearest OJ as last target and highlights them glacial.

AttackNearestEnemy.name: AttackNearestEnemy
description: Attacks nearest OJ human.

AttackNearest.name: AttackNearest
description: Attacks nearest mobile (human or creature).

ScrollNearTargets_delete.name: ScrollNearTargets_delete
description: Scrolls through the closest three (variable) targets to the Player as default or a selected Caller.

SetCaller.name: SetCaller
description: Set the caller for PvP.  Used for the 'ScrollNearTargets' function.

CallerDistance.name: CallerDistance
description: Returns the distance between the caller selected with 'SetCaller' and a set of coordinates. Used for sorting the distance of the 'ScrollNearTargets' function.

ScrollNearTargets.name: ScrollNearTargets
description: Scrolls through the closest, variable number of OJ targets (default 3).  If a caller is set, it will scroll through the 3 nearest targets to the caller (and player if caller not on screen).

PvPSetTarget.name: PvPSetTarget
description: Support function that takes a passed in object class, sets highlights them to the color that has been selected in the gump (or glacial as default) and sets the object as your Last Target.

AttackNearestOJ.name: AttackNearestOJ
description: Searches for the nearest OJ with 20 tiles and attacks them.

TargetNearestCreature.name: TargetNearestCreature
description: Sets the closest non-human mobile as last target and attacks it.

FindHurtAlly.name: FindHurtAlly
description: Combines all Green humans and friends list and targets the lowest HP on screen.  If "swap back to LT" is selected, it will also swap back to the previous last target.

AbilityToggle.name: AbilityToggle
description: This is the function that is called as an external function in Hotkeys in the OA. The syntax is as follows: AbilityToggle("primary","true"); You can change "primary" for "secondary", and the true sets whether or not the script keeps the ability toggled.

AutoRearm.name: AutoRearm
description: A script that runs in the background to auto-rearm your weapon (can be selected in the gump to only do so if you are disarmed).

ToggleRearm.name: ToggleRearm
description: Function that can be hot-keyed in the OA to toggle auto-rearm on and off.

DismountSecondary.name: DismountSecondary
description: Dismounts your mount and activates your secondary ability.

AttackLT_Closest_Refresh.name: AttackLT_Closest_Refresh
description: Attacks the closest target to you, your last target and if your stamina is below 90% (or a value set in the gump), chugs a refresh.  If your LT is just as close to you as the the next closest target, it will flag your LT last (to make sure you are attacking it).  This is spammable.

AttackLast_Refresh.name: AttackLast_Refresh
description: Attacks your last attack target, and chugs a refresh if your stamina is below 90% (or the value set in the gump).

DressPreferredAbility.name: DressPreferredAbility
description: This is a function to be added as a hotkey in the OA, external code.  The purpose is to specify a dress group that is a weapon, and the ability you'd like it to turn on when you arm that weapon.\nExample:\nDressPreferredAbility("wep_bokuto", "secondary")

Dachi_Dismount.name: Dachi_Dismount
description: Using your last target as a reference, once activated waits until you are within 2 tiles, and then dismounts, then activates secondary to dismount the target.  This function hasn't been tested in some time, may not work properly.

SpamAttackLast.name: SpamAttackLast
description: Spams attack last while the script is running.

DisarmLeftHand.name: DisarmLeftHand
description: Disarms your left hand

SampAbility.name: SampAbility
description: Support function for PvM, it references a global that I don't think is set in the latest pack.

AutoCouterAttack_standalone.name: AutoCouterAttack_standalone
description: Function will run in the background to auto counter-attack.  This is not required if you set this to active in the gump pack.
